text:
Connor: Heads-up — deploy-bot failed promotion to prod after postupgrade hook in payments-chart 1.3.8.
Maria: saw alert, logs show hook timeout on migrate-job, think values override for DB_MAX_CONN was missing.
Devon: hmm, staging passed earlier? which values file got applied in canary?
deploy-bot: promotion blocked: postupgrade-hook timeout (migrate-job) — automatic rollback prevented by manual-pin flag.
Linh: can confirm canary used chart 1.3.7 + values/payments-canary.yaml; the payload for prod referenced values/payments-prod.yaml which still points at 1.3.8 overlay.
Connor: So mismatch between chart version and values overlay — overlay expects new init container.
Maria: That init container fails with OOM on nodeclass small — that explains hook crash.
SRE-Oncall: We should either pin prod to 1.3.7 or hotpatch the init container mem request. What's the quick fix?
Devon: We can push a tiny patch to 1.3.8 that removes the init container and re-run, but release window closes in 30m.
ReleaseManager: Two options: manual pin to 1.3.7 and resume promotion, or hotpatch 1.3.8 and re-run canary then promote. Need consensus.
Connor: I vote pin. Production has traffic sensitivity and we don't have rollback tested for migration.
Linh: Pin + assemble release notes noting chart rollback and follow-up hotfix ticket.
Maria: I'll assemble notes and trigger a manual pin. Connor — can you coordinate with infra to unfreeze the deploy-bot?
Connor: on it. tagging @deploy-bot unfreeze? (:pray:)
deploy-bot: manual override received by Connor. Pinning payments-chart to 1.3.7 for prod. Resuming promotion to prod.
SRE-Oncall: monitor migration jobs and hook timeouts; I'll keep a watch window for 45m.
ReleaseManager: I'll create ticket RM-4691 for backport hotfix to 1.3.8 and update the release notes. Maria, please include exact diffs and timeline.
Maria: will do — pushing draft now: "Prod pinned to 1.3.7 due to postupgrade hook init container memory regression in 1.3.8; hotfix planned." Will post once ready.
Connor: thanks all. keep updates here; if promote bot errors again we'll roll back to stable image digest. :thumbsup:
